V1S1.beat: overhead POV on asphalt; left hand holds the right shoe top-down (insole up, toe pointing up), turns it to a side view, back to top-down and pushes it toward the lens

VIEW AND FRAMING FIRST: recreate Image 1 exactly: a straight-down phone POV looking at her own legs on grey asphalt, black leggings from the bottom edge, her LEFT foot (frame left) wears the LEFT shoe, fully inside it and laced; her RIGHT foot (frame right) is BARE with a white pedicure and a thin silver anklet. Her LEFT arm enters from the lower-left edge in a red knit sweater whose sleeve has silver rhinestone brooch patches, and her LEFT hand holds ONE shoe, the RIGHT shoe of the pair, seen from straight above with the toe pointing to the top of the frame and the cream insole showing, gripping its outer side with four fingers behind and the thumb in front. THE SHOE (must match the product sheet and close-ups exactly, colour for colour): Vans Old Skool low-top sneaker in tartan plaid canvas: a very dark oil-green, near-black ground with red bands, thin white lines and thin yellow lines in a square grid; one smooth WHITE leather curved side stripe on each side; WHITE flat laces through brass/antique-gold metal eyelets; white padded collar lining; plaid tongue; white rubber sidewall with one thin black stripe around it; gum-brown waffle outsole; CREAM insole printed with a black rectangle outline holding the black 'VANS' skateboard logo set diagonally; on the white heel sidewall a small WHITE label with the black 'VANS OFF THE WALL' skateboard logo. No sequins, no glitter, no checkerboard, no silver eyelets, no other logos. SKIN: every hand, wrist, ankle and foot in the frame has Grace's exact skin: the warm medium-deep brown skin tone shown in the Grace reference image(s), even and natural, the same tone on hands and feet. Take ONLY the skin tone from those images; ignore their rings, bracelets, watch, anklets, shoes and backgrounds. Real smartphone photo, sharp focus, natural texture, 9:16 vertical. Hands enter from the frame edge with whole wrists, five fingers, nothing seen through the hand. No text, no captions, no stickers, no emoji, no watermark, no logos other than the real Vans marks. No sparkle or light effects. Ignore any smudge or small mark in Image 1.
V1S1.clip: Recreate Image1 exactly as the first frame. Image1 is the approved first frame, Image2 the real insole logo, Image3 the real side of the shoe, Image4 the product sheet. Over 8 seconds, in one continuous take, the hand keeps the SAME grip on the shoe the whole time: for the first 3 seconds it holds the shoe still, top-down, with small natural hand movement; then it slowly tilts the shoe a quarter turn so its outer side faces the camera, the white side stripe clearly visible, toe pointing to the right, held at the same height; for the last 2 seconds it tilts it back top-down and brings it slowly closer to the lens until the insole fills the top half of the frame. The shoe never flips over, never shows its sole, never changes size or colours; the plaid, white stripe, white laces, brass eyelets and cream insole with the black VANS logo match Image2, Image3 and Image4 in every frame. The worn shoe on her left foot, her bare right foot and the bag stay still. Her skin stays the same warm medium-deep brown in every frame. Camera: handheld phone, steady, looking straight down. No music, no voice, no text, no sparkle.
